basis: Source-confirmed design case: history applies validated old rows to SessionManager or ShopperReflex and records person history without consulting erasure state; fanDecisions/fanOutcome post to DecisionRing/LearnStats without consulting erasure state. The ledger barrier is retained and inclusive but these paths bypass it.
source_observations: src/identity/history.ts applyHistory groups and writes every eligible row without a tombstone read.
src/learn/fan.ts fanDecisions posts all records to ring and personalized exposures; fanOutcome posts every outcome.
src/ledger/erasure.ts retains validated pending tombstones after physical rewrite and defines hidden as ts <= erased_at.
acceptance: One exact three-fixture K1, app noEmit, scoped diff/whitespace, then independent exact K1 review. No new suite or performance programme.
rollback: Retain an equivalent active-cutoff enforcement path; deleting the guard reopens both replay paths.
